name: Devon Parts
description: A package that contains Devon's machine parts.

gifts.note: Story: beat the Team Aqua Grunt. After you earn Badge 1, a Team Aqua Grunt steals the Devon Goods in Rustboro City and flees into Rusturf Tunnel with Mr. Briney's Peeko. Beat him in the tunnel and he hands back the Devon Parts, which you later deliver to Capt. Stern in Slateport City.
